invitation.title: Dear friends and family!
invitation.body:
With great joy, we invite your family to share with us one of the most important and happiest days of our lives — our wedding day!

We would be delighted to have you by our side on this special occasion. We dream of celebrating it surrounded by family and close friends, sharing joy, warm emotions, sincere smiles, and creating memories that will stay with us for many years to come.

This day will be filled with love, happiness, laughter, and a heartfelt atmosphere, and we truly want you to be part of it. Your presence will be the most precious gift for us and will make this celebration even more special.

We look forward to seeing you and sharing this beautiful day together with you!
